# Choir Rehearsal Summary

## Key Points  
Marta led the warm-up and focused on breathing techniques for ten minutes, helping singers improve their vocal control.  
Owen arrived late due to a delayed bus, but he quickly joined the group and contributed during the rehearsal.  
The folk song "Down by the River" was performed, with Priya noting that the altos tend to rush the second verse.  
The group slowed the tempo and practiced clapping the rhythm together to improve timing and cohesion.  
Marta suggested marking breath points in everyone's sheet music to help with phrasing and transitions.  
The tenors continue to struggle with the high note near the end of the piece, requiring further attention.  
Tea and biscuits were provided by the hall committee, creating a welcoming atmosphere.  
The spring concert has been scheduled for the second Saturday of April.  
Priya will book two additional rehearsals in March to ensure the group is well-prepared.  

## Next Steps  
Everyone should bring a pencil and a water bottle to the next rehearsal.  
Owen has offered to print fresh copies of the score before Friday, which will help with consistency.  
The group will continue working on breath points and vocal timing in upcoming sessions.  
Priya will coordinate the booking of the extra rehearsals in March.  
Marta will lead the next warm-up and focus on vocal endurance.  
The next rehearsal is scheduled to start at seven thirty sharp, and punctuality is expected.  
All singers should review their sheet music and prepare for the high note in the final section.  
Owen will ensure the score is available for all members by Friday.  
Marta and Priya will meet after rehearsal to discuss progress and adjustments.  
The group will practice the rhythm and phrasing together to build confidence.  
We will evaluate the performance of the folk song in the next session.  
Owen and Marta will share feedback on the group’s progress during the next meeting.  
Priya will confirm the hall booking details and share them with the choir by the end of the week.
